texts.en:
The Shroud. It flows high beneath our known reality, a shadow cast by darkness.

Though we have long ventured into this psionic realm, our earlier forays were only tentative. Now, after years spent wearing down the veil between dimensions with our combined minds, we sense it clearly enough to explore with purpose.

On the other side, our efforts have not gone unnoticed. The [GetChosenPatron] awaits us.

UNFURL. ENWRAP. EXPAND.

In this maelstrom of countless entities, its clarity is a promise.
